en: Color postcard showing an alpine-style hotel/inn with a steep triangular entrance, stone chimney, wood balconies and a large terrace, set among fir trees and low mountains. People walk and sit outside; period Romanian cars are parked in front. The back has Romanian handwriting, three Romanian stamps and a cancellation from Vrancea county. The printed caption names the place as the Soveja Inn.
